findings.title: DHS Contracts - Distributed Denial of Secrets
findings.summary_md: Distributed Denial of Secrets published a dataset titled DHS Contracts containing details on ICE and DHS contracts with over 6,000 entities, ranging from private businesses to government agencies and universities. The data was provided by the hacktivist group known as the Department of Peace, which also claimed responsibility for the later Icepick employee-data leak. Notable firms named in the contracts include Anduril, L3Harris, Raytheon, Palantir, Microsoft, and Oracle.

findings.title: Hacktivists claim to have hacked Homeland Security to release ICE contract data - TechCrunch
findings.summary_md: A hacktivist group calling itself the Department of Peace claimed to have breached Homeland Security systems and published internal contractor records tied to ICE, covering more than 6,000 companies. The material, which included defense contractors and technology vendors, was distributed through the transparency nonprofit DDoSecrets. The same group later provided the DHS employee dataset published as Icepick in October 2026.
